name: Wistron Corporation
summary: Wistron Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of information technology products in the United States, Europe, China, and internationally. The company develops and produces desktop computers, notebook computers, motherboards, servers, system platforms, multi-CPU computer systems, multimedia computers, network computers, consumer computers, micro-processors, CD-ROMs, PDAs, panel PCs, pocket computers, and interface cards. It also offers professional display systems, industrial PCs, and data storage equipment.
